column7: Usernames created or renamed in core must be ASCII ([A-Za-z0-9 ._@+-]) without edge/repeated whitespace, so fullwidth/NBSP/ideographic-space variants of an existing name cannot become a second principal (identity.NewFoldedName does not fold them; no re-key migration, ask identity-fold-space-width (b)). Rename: TestUpdateUser_RenameRejectsSpoofedUsernames; stored legacy names keep working: TestLegacyStoredUsernameFailingRule_KeepsWorking; IdP paths normalize: TestProvisionSCIMUser_NonASCIIUserNameProvisions, TestProvisionSSOUser_NonASCIIEmailProvisions.
